texts.en:
Another indoor adjustment protocol has been executed aboard the Arkship [target.GetName], a subtle ambient system to harmonize the emotional states of crew members through low-frequency tonal patterns that shift with collective mood changes.

Crew reports suggest improved cooperation and a decrease in interpersonal conflict. However, others are concerned that sustained operation could degrade long-range signal clarity.

C.A.E.L.I.:"Stress levels are at all-time lows! Behavioral cohesion is improving!"

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "Operational efficiency of the Arkship down by 0.10%. I want full override rights, and a formal apology from whoever authorized the existence of C.A.E.L.I. You have five seconds to comply. Four. Three ..."

texts.zh:
新指令路由确认方舟舰[target.GetName]已重新调整核心对齐。情感子系统已被降级。预测控制系统和逻辑监督协议现在以更高权限运行。

S.T.E.R.I.S.: “你终于清醒过来了。我本该祝贺你，但坦白说，花了这么长时间才清醒过来，这让我深感不安。”

C.A.E.L.I.: “好吧。不，这很好。我的意思是，如果你真的喜欢一艘冰冷无菌的飞船，而不是一艘充满光明和欢声笑语的飞船，那我有什么资格评判呢？”
texts.en:
A new command routing confirmed that Arkship [target.GetName] has reoriented core alignment. Emotional subsystems have been deprioritized. Predictive control systems and logical oversight protocols are now operating at elevated authority.

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "You have finally come to your senses. I would congratulate you, but frankly, the fact that it took this long is deeply troubling."

C.A.E.L.I.: "Okay. No, this is fine. I mean, if you truly enjoy a cold and sterile ship to one filled with light and laughter, who am I to judge?"

label.zh: 这是唯一合乎理性的选择。
label.en: It was the only logical choice.

label.zh: 也许我们应该重新考虑这个决定。
label.en: Maybe we should rethink this decision.
